mathematical_contract.authority: the existing Hypercurve implicit graph/cell certifier remains the sole topology authority and Hypersolve parameter_component_bivariate_polynomial_system remains the sole exact common-factor/division authority
mathematical_contract.characteristic_zero_identity: for a primitive characteristic-zero component H, every repeated geometric factor divides both H and the derivative with respect to the lifted parameter
mathematical_contract.retry_boundary: ordinary square-free certification runs first and returns immediately on success; Hypersolve factor extraction is invoked only after that topology path declines or is uncertain
mathematical_contract.exact_reduction: each accepted Hypersolve Rational or Implicit report supplies H divided exactly by one or more derivative-shared factors as its first residual equation
mathematical_contract.termination: every retry must strictly lower the stored bidegree sum; no iteration cap, approximate degree decision, or heuristic negative participates
mathematical_contract.unit_invariance: Hypersolve may normalize the reduced support by any exact nonzero rational unit; topology depends only on its zero set
mathematical_contract.multiplicity_semantics: factor multiplicity is algebraic evidence, not duplicate geometry; each square-free support branch is transported once
mathematical_contract.residual_semantics: the authored equations reduced by the original common component remain untouched, so isolated residual pairs coexist with the deduplicated overlap topology
mathematical_contract.singular_semantics: after multiplicity removal, cusps, nodes, acnodes, folds, and domain events reuse the same exact singular-cell decomposition rather than a repeated-component special case
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact Hypersolve component construction, exact division, exact bidegree descent, and the existing exact topology replay
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 uses the identical factor and topology construction; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits and no approximate factor, parameter, or branch is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: a factor not exactly extractable by Hypersolve leaves the original explicit Boundary/uncertainty result in force
